$comment: Error-severity @effect/language-service diagnostics that are accepted for now. Enforced by scripts/check-effect-lsp.mjs: anything not listed here fails the build, and any entry that stops firing must be deleted. Matched by rule and file, not by line number.

accepted.reason: The diagnostic is correct in general: Schema decoding bypasses a subclass constructor, so normalization done there would be skipped. It does not apply to these classes. They are Schema.TaggedError values that are only ever constructed (`new AuthorizationDecodeError({...})`); no Schema.decode* call in src/ targets them. Their constructors validate props, deep-freeze issue paths, and set a fixed message, all of which must run on construction.
accepted.revisitIf: any of these error classes becomes part of a decoded payload
